text: Please I need help. My granddaughter is 5 and her temperature is 39.9. She won't put her chin down. I asked her to look at her tummy and she can't do it, she cries and keeps her head back. Her breathing is very quick and you can see her ribs sucking in with each breath, and she's making a little grunting noise. I checked for a rash with a glass and there isn't one. Her mother is on her way back. What do I do, should I call an ambulance
